items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I made "Cindy, Oh Cindy" with Vince Vincent Martin.

ctx.x: Congratulations. Say, look, you got such a magnificent resume here. I think it really should be read because I'm sure that the young people would want to know, or the people in the future would want to know some of the wonderful things that you have done and some things you've accomplished here, Panama. Would you like to read this and we'll just talk about it, because I think everybody should know about all of the -- especially these studio recordings; the hits you played on, just tell them some of the hits you…
Well, let's see; I made "Cindy, Oh Cindy" with Vince Vincent Martin.
